page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, this instance provides dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

The hardware profile offers high compute density due to the dedicated physical cores and high clock speed, which supports workloads requiring consistent CPU performance. However, the lack of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which introduces network latency and additional resource management considerations. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a balanced resource allocation for compute-heavy tasks that do not require massive memory arrays.

This configuration is suitable for multi-threaded applications, batch processing, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that benefit from dedicated physical CPU cores and high clock speeds without requiring GPU acceleration.
